subject: MAP telescope — reprofile close window & risk ledger
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sara King <sara.king@polaris.com>, Ben Holt <ben.holt@polaris.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP telescope — reprofile close window & risk ledger

Hi Sara / Ben,

Quick note after this morning's gate review: the evaluation has slipped against the MAP's QA block due to two items — Polaris security review running longer than expected, and a delay in procurement confirmation for the dedicated sandbox. That combination pushes our earliest realistic close beyond the original 11/15 target.

To keep momentum and avoid losing the desired deployment window, I'd like to propose a controlled rebaseline: move the close target to 2028-12-15, split the evaluation into a staged acceptance (core feature pass -> extended stress and compliance pass), and log the primary risks in the attached MAP draft (polaris_map_draft_v3.xlsx).

Asks:
- Can Polaris confirm whether a 2-week extension is acceptable (new internal target 11/29 for procurement sign-off)?
- Would an abbreviated QA scope for the initial stage (functional + security smoke) be acceptable so we can ship the first milestone earlier?
- Polaris procurement: if you can get the PO & contract signatures in the next 10 business days, we can keep the rebaseline conservative.

I'll tag Markus to draft an SLA exception if needed and Laura to help align procurement steps. Rishi, can you confirm which gating tests absolutely must run in stage 1 vs stage 2?

Thanks — attaching MAP v3 (draft) and a short risk register.

Regards,
Naomi
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: polaris_map_draft_v3.xlsx (MAP + risk ledger)

From: Sara King <sara.king@polaris.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Holt <ben.holt@polaris.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-04T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP telescope — reprofile close window & risk ledger

Naomi —

Thanks for the flag and the updated MAP. We ran into an internal security scheduling conflict that bumped our review two cycles; that was the root cause. Procurement is aware and pushing, but I need to be candid: our legal team requested additional CLARIFICATIONS on data retention and audit logging which adds ~7 business days.

We're open to a rebaseline to 12/15 provided Redwood can commit to the staged acceptance approach you outlined. Two quick items:
- Procurement aim: we are targeting 2028-11-20 for PO issuance (not a firm signature yet). I've attached our procurement timeline for visibility.
- Exec ask: Ben wants a short note from Redwood summarizing the staged acceptance criteria and the proposed SLA exception to present to our CFO.

I'll review the MAP and get back with any redlines by end of day Friday.

Sara
Sara King
Head of Platform Ops, Polaris Systems

Attachments: polaris_procurement_schedule.pdf (internal timeline)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sara King <sara.king@polaris.com>, Ben Holt <ben.holt@polaris.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-04T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP telescope — reprofile close window & risk ledger

Appreciate the transparency, Sara.

Markus — can you draft a concise SLA exception note Ben can take to his CFO (one page max: impact, mitigation, credit proposal, duration)? Laura — can you confirm whether procurement can accept a conditional PO (signing contingent on one outstanding compliance doc) to speed things?

Rishi — temporary question for you: for the staged acceptance, which automated tests are non-negotiable in stage 1 (must-run) vs stage 2 (can defer)? I want to call those out explicitly in the MAP so Ben has a clean doc for exec review.

I'll update the MAP (v3 -> v3b) after we capture these inputs.

Thanks,
Naomi

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Sara King <sara.king@polaris.com>, Ben Holt <ben.holt@polaris.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-05T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP telescope — reprofile close window & risk ledger

Naomi / Sara —

Drafting the SLA exception now. High-level proposal: if Polaris confirms the conditional PO by 2028-11-20, Redwood will:
- Grant a one-time SLA credit equal to 10% of the first three months' platform fees should the final go-live slip beyond 2028-12-15 due to procurement delays on Polaris side.
- Commit to a staged acceptance plan (functional pass within 10 business days of sandbox access; extended compliance run completed within 30 days).
- Provide a temporary dedicated sandbox with extended logging retention to support your security review.

I'll attach the formal request (SLA_exception_request.pdf) and a one-page exec summary for Ben. Naomi — please review before I send to Ben.

-Markus
Director, Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SLA_exception_request.pdf (formal exception request)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Sara King <sara.king@polaris.com>, Ben Holt <ben.holt@polaris.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-07T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP telescope — reprofile close window & risk ledger

Hi all —

Technical split for staged acceptance (recommended):
Stage 1 (must-run before initial sign-off):
- Functional validation: intent routing, latency under nominal load, response correctness for the 6 core flows listed in the MAP.
- Security smoke: tokenization verified, audit log capture enabled, and a light pen-test checklist (surface scan, auth flows).

Stage 2 (deferred to compliance window):
- Full load/stress tests (24h soak), data-retention policy validation across all pipelines, and extended penetration testing.

Mitigation to shorten calendar impact: we can provide a pre-provisioned, isolated sandbox cluster (2 GPUs) within 72 hours of PO confirmation and a Redwood engineering liaison to run the heavy compliance tests in parallel with Polaris' legal review. That should reduce the calendar delta by ~7–10 business days.

Please indicate which of the Stage 1 items Polaris considers mandatory; I'll mark them as must-run in the MAP.

-Rishi
Principal Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Holt <ben.holt@polaris.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Sara King <sara.king@polaris.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-09T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP telescope — reprofile close window & risk ledger

Team —

Thanks for the clear options. Polaris is prepared to accept the 12/15 close target, contingent on the staged acceptance approach and Redwood's willingness to provision the isolated sandbox immediately upon conditional PO. Procurement confirmed they will aim to issue the conditional PO by 2028-11-20; final signature will follow legal clearance.

Sara and I reviewed the Stage 1 list; we agree the functional validation and security smoke are mandatory for initial sign-off. Stage 2 will include the full soak and pen test. Ben to provide an executive note confirming acceptance and attaching the signed MAP once Naomi/Markus send the one-page SLA exception.

Please proceed — we'll expect the updated MAP (v3b) and the SLA exec summary in the next 48 hours.

Ben Holt
Chief Product Officer, Polaris Systems

Attachments: signed_map_v3.pdf (signed copy of MAP v3, subject to SLA exception)
